protocol.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; schema_version exactly 1.0.0; unknown request fields rejected; immutable bytes and SHA256
protocol.python_port: HistoryOwnerPort.acquire(request_json: bytes, *, cancellation: CancellationSignal) -> await bytes
protocol.python_request: HistoricalRequest(data: bytes); decode returns a fresh object; sha256 covers exact caller bytes
protocol.host_field: HostPorts.ibkr_history / HostContext.ibkr_history optional, default None; real owner/binding NOT mounted
protocol.native_entry: HistoryAdapter::from_existing_owner(Arc<Client>, OwnerIdentity, HashMap<String,QualifiedEquity>, Arc<SharedHistoryBudget>, Arc<dyn OwnerAdmission>, Capabilities); acquire_json(&[u8], CancellationToken) -> Result<Capture, static error>

bars.end_unix_seconds: REQUIRED nullable field: TRADES integer 946684800..4102444800, not future; ADJUSTED_LAST explicit null only

bid_ask_ticks.session_end_unix_seconds: same range, >start, span <=86400 seconds, not future; these are bounds, not automatic calendar qualification

capture_fields.effective_request: actual SDK argument semantics: what_to_show/bar_size/duration/end/use_rth/format_date=2/keep_up_to_date=false; or BID_ASK anchor/count/use_rth/ignore_size=false/pages=1
capture_fields.owner: generation, endpoint_ref, build_ref: opaque identities only
capture_fields.acquisition: started_unix_ns, finished_unix_ns, elapsed_monotonic_ns: decimal strings; actual acquisition, not historical arrival
capture_fields.attempts: logical_calls 0|1; internal_count 0|1|null; upper_bound 0|1; reserved_history_weight 0|1|2; reserved_api_messages 0|2; dispatch_outcome and sdk_request_id when available
capture_fields.source_response_complete: true only after strict terminal, no error/loss/bound/deadline; not market coverage or raw-wire certification
capture_fields.capture_complete: true only when bounded capture retained terminal response without truncation/error
capture_fields.data_valid: basic decoded timestamp/numeric/OHLC/session checks only; requires capture_complete; NOT rights/calendar/coverage/PIT qualification
capture_fields.admissible: false HERE means acquisition cannot grant research/dataset admission. A subsequent separately reviewed authority may admit a qualified capture.
capture_fields.owner_slot_quarantined: true for dispatched request without strict terminal; cancellation send receipt does not resolve uncertainty
capture_fields.provider_window: null or decoded bar end-frame {start,end}, each {unix_ns:decimal string,offset_seconds:integer}
capture_fields.events: bounded [{ordinal,kind,detail,acquired_unix_ns}]; request notices/errors, bar data/end or tick done events; exceeding event/byte bounds is explicitly incomplete
capture_fields.limitations: SDK fidelity, adjustment, clocks, cancellation and bounds limitations

protocol.bar_row: type=bar; provider_timestamp={kind:date,sdk_decoded_label:YYYY-MM-DD} OR {kind:datetime,value:{unix_ns,offset_seconds}}; open_f64_bits,high_f64_bits,low_f64_bits,close_f64_bits,volume_f64_bits,wap_f64_bits exactly16 lowercase hex IEEE754 bits; trade_count i32; decoded_receive_ordinal integer; acquired_unix_ns decimal string
protocol.tick_row: type=bid_ask_tick; provider_timestamp={unix_ns,offset_seconds}; provider_timestamp_precision=seconds; bid_f64_bits,ask_f64_bits exactly16 lowercase hex; bid_size_i32,ask_size_i32 signed SDK i32; bid_past_low,ask_past_high booleans; decoded_receive_ordinal; acquired_unix_ns
protocol.ordering: No sorting, deduplication, OHLC correction, magnification, rounding, negative-volume zeroing or re-timestamping. Receive ordinal is provenance, not exchange tie order. Original numeric spelling/presence and tick batch boundaries are unavailable.
protocol.adjustment: TRADES split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted. ADJUSTED_LAST split/dividend-adjusted with real no-end/provider-now semantics; neither is PIT corporate-action evidence. BID_ASK ticks are not BID_ASK aggregate bars.

strict_extension.bar_terminal: Existing codecs show HistoricalData contains decoded rows but start/end are epoch placeholders. Strict source completion requires HistoricalData followed by genuine HistoricalDataEnd carrying decoded start/end. Unexpected/duplicate/missing terminal, request error, and channel lag fail closed. Zero rows with a valid terminal is a complete empty response, not coverage proof.
strict_extension.tick_terminal: Opt-in strict mode must precede first poll. Completion requires SDK batch done=true, all buffered rows drained, no error/lag/premature close/cancellation. Batch boundaries remain SDK-private.
strict_extension.retry: Strict bar path sends once using existing encoder/request builder; ticks send once. No hidden retry. A pre-handle failed/interrupted dispatch has unknown internal_count with upper_bound1, not a fabricated send receipt.
strict_extension.cancellation: Checked per-request cancellation returns local send result only, not imaginary broker acknowledgment. No shared-client disconnect. Drop is best effort; unresolved dispatch quarantines the shared owner history slot.
strict_extension.default_behavior: Original fetch/stream/cancel/default tick behavior and all wire codecs/transports remain unchanged. Exactly two vendored source files changed.

pacing.owner_history_budget: One outstanding request; conservative chosen owner policy60 weighted units/600s, maximum5 per contract/2s, identical cooldown15s reserved through the whole possible send interval. NOT a claim that official small-bar numeric rules apply universally to minute/daily bars or ticks.
pacing.weight: bars1, BID_ASK2; strict requests have no internal retry
pacing.global_api: OwnerAdmission must atomically fence expected generation and reserve2 possible API messages through deadline across ALL connection users. This concrete owner implementation remains a prerequisite, not the old HTTP cost1 gate.
pacing.quarantine: RAII reservation quarantines unresolved dispatch, timeout, external future drop or error. Worker has no reset/disconnect/reconnect. Genuine terminal releases the slot independently of later dataset validity/coverage qualification.
